# Advaya AI Dental

> Advaya AI Dental builds three AI systems for dental clinics in India, the US, UAE and UK: an AI Receptionist that answers calls and WhatsApp only from clinic-approved policies, a Missed Call Manager that replies to every missed call within a minute and ranks callbacks, and a Recovery Desk that books diagnosed-but-unscheduled treatment and overdue recall patients. Flat monthly fees, no percentage of revenue. Built by Advaya AI (advayaai.in), an AI automation agency in Mangaluru, Karnataka, India. Not affiliated with advaya.ai.

## Systems
- [AI Receptionist](https://dental.advayaai.in/ai-receptionist): answers calls and WhatsApp from approved clinic information, books into Google Sheets or the clinic's CRM, hands anything clinical or urgent to staff.
- [Missed Call Manager](https://dental.advayaai.in/missed-call-manager): WhatsApp or SMS reply to every missed call within a minute plus a ranked callback list; keeps the clinic's existing number.
- [Recovery Desk](https://dental.advayaai.in/recovery-desk): done-for-you recovery of unscheduled treatment and overdue recall patients over WhatsApp, SMS and callbacks; 30-day pilot.

## Trust and compliance
- [Patient data and compliance](https://dental.advayaai.in/patient-data): which vendors handle patient data, which agreements they sign (BAA, DPA), HIPAA for US practices and the DPDP Act 2023 for India.
